A good product card does a lot of quiet work. It’s the thing that stops the scroll on Instagram, sits at the top of your listing, and turns a plain product into something that looks worth buying. The problem is that making one usually means wrestling with design software you don’t really know, or paying someone who does.
This tool skips all of that. Fill in your product details, upload an image, pick a style, and watch a clean, professional card build itself in a live preview. Download it as a PNG or PDF and you’re ready to post. Free, no signup, and everything happens in your browser.
👉 Open the Free Product Card Generator
What Goes On the Card
The card is built from a handful of details, and you see each one appear in the live preview as you type. Here’s what you can add:

• Product image — upload a PNG, JPG, or WebP (up to 10MB)

• Product name and a short description

• Badge text — like “SALE”, “NEW”, or “HOT” to catch the eye

• Star rating — from 1 to 5

• Pricing — sale price and original price, so the discount shows

• Stock and shipping labels — like “In Stock” or “Free Shipping”

• Currency — pick the right symbol for your market

• Call-to-action button — with custom text and a buy link

• Brand logo — add your own for a branded look
Everything updates in real time on the right, so there’s no guessing how it’ll turn out.
Four Templates to Set the Tone
The same product can look completely different depending on the style. You get four templates:

• Modern — clean and current, the safe all-rounder

• Minimal — stripped back, lets the product speak

• Bold — high-impact, good for grabbing attention

• Elegant — refined, suited to premium products
Pair that with an adjustable card size, and you can shape the card for wherever it’s going, a square for Instagram, a taller card for Pinterest, and so on.
Building Your Card, Step by Step

• Open the Product Card Generator

• Upload your product image

• Fill in the name, description, badge, and rating

• Add your pricing, plus stock and shipping labels

• Set up the CTA button and buy link if you want one

• Choose a template, size, and add your brand logo

• Pick PNG or PDF and hit Download Card (or copy it)
The whole thing takes a few minutes, and you can tweak any detail and re-download as often as you like.
About That Buy Link (Read This)
One detail worth understanding, because it trips people up. The card lets you add a clickable buy link, but how it behaves depends on the format:

• PDF and the live preview — the link is clickable

• Image formats (PNG/JPG) — the link can’t be clickable, because images don’t support links
So if you’re sharing a PNG on social media, the buy link won’t be tappable in the image itself. The fix is simple: put your link in the caption or bio alongside the card. On platforms where you share a PDF, the link works directly.
Where These Cards Get Used

• E-commerce stores — product thumbnails and listing images

• Instagram and Facebook — shoppable-looking posts that stop the scroll

• Pinterest — product pins that drive clicks

• WhatsApp and catalogues — send clean product cards to customers

• Ads and marketing — polished visuals without a designer

• Dropshippers and resellers — quick, professional product images at scale
Getting a Card That Actually Converts

• Use a clean, well-lit product image on a plain background, it makes the biggest difference of anything here.

• Show both prices. Displaying the original alongside the sale price makes the discount obvious and tempting.

• Keep the description short and benefit-led. “Noise-cancelling, 30-hour battery” beats a paragraph.

• Use the badge sparingly. One “SALE” or “NEW” draws the eye; too much clutter kills it.

• Match the template to the product. Minimal or Elegant for premium items, Bold for deals and impulse buys.
Mistakes to Steer Clear Of

• Expecting a PNG’s buy link to work. It won’t, always add the link in your caption too.

• Overloading the card. Badge, rating, two prices, stock, shipping, and a long description all at once is too much. Pick what matters.

• Low-quality images. A blurry product photo undoes everything else.

• Forgetting your branding. Adding a logo takes seconds and makes the card look legitimate.
Privacy
Your product images and details are processed right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server, nothing is stored, and once you close the tab it’s gone. Whatever you’re building, unreleased products, private pricing, stays on your device.
Common Questions
Is it free? Yes, completely free. No Pro version, no signup, no limits. Create and download as many product cards as you want without paying anything or making an account.
Can I add a clickable buy link? Yes, and it works in the PDF and live preview. In image formats like PNG, the link can’t be clickable (images don’t support links), so share the URL in your caption alongside the card.
What formats can I download? You can download your card as a PNG image or a PDF. PNG is ideal for social media, while PDF keeps your buy link clickable.
Can I add my own logo? Yes. Upload your brand logo under Style & Branding, and it’ll appear on the card for a professional, branded look.
